Description: Enables Proton/Wine full debug log output written to ~/steam-438100.log\n\nUseful for diagnosing Proton/VRChat launch failures. Creates large log files. Source: ProtonPlus
Overrides the directory where Proton log files are written\n\ne.g. PROTON_LOG_DIR=/tmp — prevents log clutter in home directory
Enables NVIDIA NVAPI DLL emulation for DLSS and NVIDIA-specific features (e.g. Reflex).\n\nSource: ProtonPlus
Updates DLSS components for supported games via NVIDIA NGX\n\nSource: ProtonPlus
Shows an in-game DLSS status indicator\n\nSource: ProtonPlus
Enables NVIDIA-specific proprietary libraries inside Proton\n\nSource: ProtonPlus
Reports NVIDIA GPU as AMD for affected games (e.g. Reflex workaround)\n\nSource: ProtonPlus. Aligns with PROTON_HIDE_APU for AMD
Hides AMD APU from the game — use when the APU interferes with dGPU selection\n\nSource: ProtonPlus
Enables D9VK (Vulkan-based Direct3D 9) renderer instead of DXVK\n\nExperimental; try if D3D9 games have issues under DXVK
Forces OpenGL (WineD3D) fallback instead of DXVK for Direct3D 9-11\n\nSource: ProtonPlus; use when DXVK causes crashes
Enables D7VK for older Direct3D 7 and 8 era games\n\nSource: ProtonPlus; requires a compatible Proton version
Set to 0 to use FSync instead of NTSync for sync-sensitive games\n\nSource: ProtonPlus; NTSync is default in modern Proton
Forces 4GB address space support for 32-bit process (LAA flag)\n\nSource: ProtonPlus; helps prevent OOM crashes in memory-intensive content
Enables WoW64 support for 32-bit games on 64-bit Proton builds\n\nSource: ProtonPlus
Runs the game on native Wayland instead of XWayland\n\nSource: ProtonPlus
Workaround for controller detection issues — prefers SDL input over DirectInput\n\nSource: ProtonPlus
Disables Steam Input support entirely\n\nSource: ProtonPlus
Enables Proton's Discord presence bridge for rich presence in native Linux Discord\n\nSource: ProtonPlus; requires Proton 11-1 or newer
Enables Proton OptiScaler integration for DLSS/FSR/XeSS upscaling substitution\n\nSource: ProtonPlus; requires Proton 11-1 or newer
Upgrades supported FSR 3.1 games to FSR 4 via the selected custom Proton build\n\nSource: ProtonPlus; requires Proton-GE/Proton-CachyOS/Proton-EM and compatible AMD GPU
Legacy RDNA3-specific FSR 4 upgrade switch retained by older Proton-GE builds\n\nSource: ProtonPlus; prefer PROTON_FSR4_UPGRADE on newer builds
Requests ML frame generation (FSR 4 MLFG) in supported custom Proton builds\n\nSource: ProtonPlus; requires FSR 4.0.3+ and compatible AMD hardware
Forces Proton's NVAPI path — AMD Reflex last-resort fallback that can break FSR 4\n\nSource: ProtonPlus; use only after safer Reflex presets fail
Updates XeSS components in supported Intel-XeSS games\n\nSource: ProtonPlus
Enables Proton-CachyOS DXVK low-latency path for Direct3D 9-11\n\nSource: ProtonPlus; requires Proton-CachyOS build
Enables VKD3D-Proton low latency for Direct3D 12 games with Reflex markers\n\nSource: ProtonPlus; requires Proton-CachyOS; incompatible with frame gen
Enables seccomp-based syscall sandboxing for Proton processes\n\nDisable (set 0) if game crashes immediately on launch
Wine debug channel configuration — comma-separated channel:level pairs\n\ne.g. WINEDEBUG=-all,+openxr — use vrclient for VRChat-specific Wine logs
Wine DLL override map in format dllname=type (n=native b=builtin)\n\nSeparate multiple with semicolons. iyuv_32= fixes video codec issues in VRChat
Overrides the Wine prefix directory path for this game session\n\nUsually not needed — Steam sets this automatically for Proton games
Simulates page write-copy protection — fixes certain game initialization errors\n\nSource: ProtonPlus
Enables Vulkan synchronization 2 extension in Wine/Proton Vulkan layer\n\nSource: ProtonPlus
Enables futex_waitv kernel syscall for synchronization — reduces CPU overhead\n\nSource: ProtonPlus
Sets PulseAudio latency target in milliseconds\n\nSource: ProtonPlus; lower = less latency but more risk of audio glitches
Sets Wine ALSA output channel count\n\nSource: ProtonPlus; requires Proton 11-1 or newer
Enables Wine ALSA spatial downmix for 4/6/8 channel configurations\n\nSource: ProtonPlus; requires 4+ output channels via WINEALSA_CHANNELS
Exposes host machine OpenXR runtime JSON files inside the Steam container\n\nSource: community; needed for WiVRn/Monado/other host OpenXR runtimes
Grants read-write access to specific host paths inside the pressure-vessel container\n\nColon-separated absolute paths. e.g. /var/lib/flatpak/app/io.github.wivrn.wivrn
Forces the game to run on the AMD discrete GPU on hybrid graphics systems\n\nSource: ProtonPlus; set to 1 to use dGPU
Chooses the AMD Vulkan ICD — RADV (Mesa) or AMDVLK (AMD official)\n\nSource: ProtonPlus; RADV is generally preferred for gaming
Enables AMD driver shared memory staging support — improves VRAM bandwidth\n\nSource: ProtonPlus; AMD only
Controls Mesa GL threading — improves multi-threaded OpenGL performance\n\nSource: ProtonPlus; lowercase var name
Controls Mesa's on-disk shader cache — set 0 to enable / 1 to disable\n\nSource: ProtonPlus; 0=cache enabled (default), 1=disabled
Enables Mesa Anti-Lag to reduce input latency on supported AMD setups\n\nSource: ProtonPlus; AMD Mesa only

Enables experimental RADV features: comma-separated flags (rt,sam,nggc,gpl,ruse,emulate_rt)\n\nSource: ProtonPlus. rt=ray tracing,sam=Resizable BAR,nggc=NGG culling,gpl=GPL shaders,ruse=userspace queue,emulate_rt=SW ray tracing

Enables RADV debug/workaround flags: comma-separated (nocng,noabin,nobg,nodcc,novrs,nogpl,noexecbuf2,precompile,noatc)\n\nSource: ProtonPlus. nocng=no NGG,nodcc=no DCC,novrs=no VRS,precompile=precompile shaders,noatc=fixes APU texture issues
Enables AMD ACO shader compiler debug flags: comma-separated (validate,nofpgather,perfinfo,force-isel,nosched,nowave32)\n\nSource: ProtonPlus; AMD ACO compiler only
Configures DXIL-SPIR-V translation behavior — e.g. RDNA3 MLFG workaround\n\nSource: ProtonPlus; e.g. wmma_rdna3_workaround for RDNA3 MLFG
Enables Proton-CachyOS low-latency Vulkan layer with VK_AMD_anti_lag exposure\n\nSource: ProtonPlus; requires compatible game and CachyOS build
Switches CachyOS low-latency layer from Anti-Lag to VK_NV_low_latency2 (NVIDIA Reflex)\n\nSource: ProtonPlus; requires LOW_LATENCY_LAYER and game Reflex support
Makes the low-latency Vulkan layer report an NVIDIA GPU — last-resort Reflex workaround\n\nSource: ProtonPlus; can break FSR 4 — use only when all else fails
Allows DXVK-NVAPI on non-NVIDIA drivers — least-invasive AMD Reflex compatibility preset\n\nSource: ProtonPlus
Enables CachyOS NVIDIA Reflex Vulkan layer for native Vulkan games\n\nSource: ProtonPlus; requires NVIDIA and compatible CachyOS build
Configures DXVK behavior — e.g. dxgi.hideAmdGpu=True to hide AMD GPU\n\nSource: ProtonPlus; e.g. dxgi.hideAmdGpu=True for Reflex GPU spoof
Enables DXVK-NVAPI. Use PROTON_ENABLE_NVAPI instead when using Proton\n\nStandalone DXVK installations
Shows DXVK Vulkan overlay with GPU/frame timing stats\n\nCombine with commas: DXVK_HUD=fps,gpus,memory — useful for performance profiling
Enables asynchronous shader compilation in DXVK to reduce stutter\n\nSource: ProtonPlus; may cause visual artifacts during shader warmup — requires patched DXVK
Caps DXVK frame rate to specified value (frames per second — 0=uncapped)\n\nSource: ProtonPlus; overrides in-game frame limiter via Vulkan layer
Controls DXVK logging verbosity\n\nSource: ProtonPlus. none=silent,error=critical only,debug=verbose
Enables DXVK pipeline state cache for faster shader reuse between sessions\n\nDisable if you have persistent shader bugs after game updates

Configures VKD3D-Proton behavior — comma-separated flags (shader_cache,force_host_cache,upload_hvv,no_upload_hvv,nodxr,dxr11,dxr10,gpuva,stable_power_state,...)\n\nSource: ProtonPlus. nodxr=disable RT,dxr11=enable RT,shader_cache=disk cache,upload_hvv=ReBAR staging,gpuva=GPU VA
Controls VKD3D logging verbosity\n\nSource: ProtonPlus. none=muted,err=critical,warn=warnings,fixme=missing features,info=general,trace=verbose
Enables VKD3D-Proton internal on-disk shader cache to reduce stuttering\n\nSource: ProtonPlus
Enables GPU Virtual Addressing in VKD3D-Proton — helps open-world games with D3D12 memory\n\nSource: ProtonPlus
ScopeBuddy: Enables automatic Variable Refresh Rate matching to game FPS\n\nSource: ProtonPlus; requires ScopeBuddy wrapper
Enables MangoHUD performance overlay (Vulkan env mode — see also gamemoderun wrapper)\n\nSource: ProtonPlus; install mangohud separately; use MANGOHUD=1
Configures MangoHUD overlay display options (comma-separated)\n\ne.g. fps,gpu_stats,cpu_stats,ram
Enables vkBasalt post-processing layer (sharpening/color grading) on top of VRChat\n\nInstall vkbasalt; configure via /etc/vkBasalt.conf or VKBASALT_CONFIG_FILE
Specifies path to specific Vulkan ICD driver JSON file (overrides default GPU)\n\ne.g. /usr/share/vulkan/icd.d/nvidia_icd.json — use to force specific GPU
Alternative to VK_ICD_FILENAMES — specifies Vulkan driver JSON files\n\ne.g. /usr/share/vulkan/icd.d/radeon_icd.x86_64.json
Overrides Vulkan window surface present mode (vsync behavior)\n\nmailbox=low-latency,immediate=no-vsync,fifo=vsync
